sloka: व्यसृजन् कबलान्नागा गावो वत्सान्न पाययन् ।पुत्रम् प्रथमजम् लब्ध्वा जननी नाभ्यनन्दत ॥२-४१-१०॥
transliteration: vyasṛjan kabalānnāgā gāvo vatsānna pāyayan ।putram prathamajam labdhvā jananī nābhyanandata ॥2-41-10॥

translations.english: Elephants dropped their morsel of food. Cows did not suckle their calves. Even the mothers were not pleased with their firstborn sons.
